items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Meanwhile, we were hiring a bass player, Herb Ward, at $75 a week. So we'd have a trio.

ctx.x: At that time, we had three and one was on the way. We had six children, but five lived. I lost one, that was a tragedy, one of the tragedies we had. But -- 19 months old.

Anyway, so I was getting a little more money all the time. So I was getting a little more money all the time. I wound up getting $110 a week before I left. And during that time, like I say, we booked Jack Teagarden and his whole band, in which we had a new clarinet player every night, even if we had to send to Philadelphia for him. And we had Lips Paige came in every Friday religiously, if he wasn't working in Blue. Red Allen came in, for free.
